title: The Man Who Stared at the Desert Sun (TE)
summary: An ascetic boasts that his spiritual willpower can overcome the midday sun. Birbal shows the court the difference between faith and stubborn folly.
full_text:
A strange, stubborn mendicant arrived in the capital during the blistering heat of June, when temperatures soared and stones blistered the feet. The mendicant announced in the marketplace:

'I have mastered the power of the mind! I can stand in the open courtyard from sunrise to sunset, staring unblinkingly directly into the blazing sun, without closing my eyelids or suffering harm! The Emperor must bow to my supreme mastery!'

Akbar was fascinated and summoned the man to the palace courtyard.

The ascetic stood upon the burning flagstones, tilted his head back, and stared up at the blinding midday sun, sweating profusely while his eyes bloodshot and teared violently.

Akbar remarked to Birbal: 'Is it not astonishing, Birbal? What divine willpower!'

Birbal stepped forward carrying a silver tray holding a small brass bowl filled with burning red charcoal and a pinch of ground black pepper.

Birbal held the bowl near the ascetic and blew gently. The invisible, pungent pepper smoke drifted into the man's nostrils and eyes.

*Achoo! Achoo! Achoo!*

The ascetic broke his posture, squeezed his eyes shut, sneezed seven times in violent convulsions, and rubbed his watering eyes with his hands, weeping: 'Water! Give me water!'

Birbal smiled gently:

'You see, Your Majesty? A man can harden his pride to stare into the sun for twenty minutes to win fame and flattery.

'Yet a single speck of common black pepper makes him sneeze and shut his eyes like an infant!

'Nature has created eyelids to protect our sight, just as reason was given to protect the soul. Defying nature out of stubborn vanity is not spiritual mastery; it is merely foolish pride waiting to be humbled by a grain of pepper.'

Akbar laughed heartily at the demonstration, advised the ascetic to use his willpower for charitable deeds rather than parlor tricks, and rewarded Birbal.
